sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Lead QA Automation Engineer (Playwright)== with **9+ years** of experience across UI and API test automation — from tool selection and framework design through script development, suite execution, and defect reporting. ==Built a Playwright + TypeScript automation framework for web applications and led Cucumber-based automation across Windows, Android, and iOS==. ==Managed test case preparation, execution, defect tracking, and status reporting as the QA lead on an automotive infotainment product==, differentiated by owning the full automation lifecycle — from framework design through CI/CD integration to defect reporting — independently.
